hints.title: Inorder Window Maintenance
hints.text: Traverse tree values in sorted order, maintaining a fixed-capacity window of size k that retains the closest values.

hints.title: Sliding Double-Ended Queue Eviction
hints.text: When the window reaches size k, compare the new candidate against the oldest element in the window; stop once candidates grow further away.

hints.title: Bounded Inorder Search
hints.text: Perform inorder traversal with a double-ended queue. If queue has fewer than k items, append node value. Else if abs(node.val - target) < abs(queue[0] - target), pop leftmost and append node.val. Otherwise break early because sorted values only move further from target.

complexity.notes: Optimal inorder windowing with early termination.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Collecting all N nodes and sorting by distance takes O(N log N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintaining a k-sized sliding deque during inorder traversal requires O(K) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use the sorted property of BST inorder traversal to evict the furthest element and prune remaining search.
